scope: First 1000 sorted base/ships PNGs from installed base package; visual text survey, not runtime approval.

findings.notes: 58x32 base panel contains two 5px text rows. Six 34x5 ACTIVE overlays have ANI offsets -20,-11 and -20,-18. Seven-pixel Korean requires coordinated panel/overlay layout work; do not simply resize the glyph inside a 5px row.

limitations: Only listed 1000 image records were visually reviewed; remaining 2903 have not been reviewed.
No readable text observed is a visual judgment, not proof of no symbols or dynamic captions.
Panel call sites, animation, color states, translated layout and runtime rendering remain pending.
Original game artwork is not included in this repository.
